purpose: Cross-project inventory of reusable blank/reference forms and templates available to the RTEC HR Process Model.
authority_rules: Reference-form presence does not establish a current HR policy or rule.
Keep version/currentness separate from form identity.
Preserve source provenance when multiple projects contain the same or related form.
Ambiguous mappings remain candidates until validated.
Employee/applicant completed forms and case records are excluded from this catalog.

source_sets.note: Scanner reference library metadata and recognition mappings. Original blank/reference artifacts are maintained outside the committed HR-GUI repository.
Reusable application/interview/denial templates stored in the project repository; backup copies are intentionally deduplicated.
Forms already fully ingested into the RTEC HR knowledge corpus.
